plan.title: Monitoring plan
plan.noneHint: No plan has been approved for this patient yet.
plan.draftPending: A draft plan is waiting for approval
plan.draftPendingHint: It does not apply until a practitioner approves it. Nothing is expected of the health worker until then.
plan.intervalLabel: How often should this patient be assessed?
plan.locationsHint: Choose the sites to record at each assessment.
plan.endHint: Leave blank for an open-ended plan.
plan.followUpHint: What the health worker should watch for. Shown to them with the plan.
plan.approvedHint: The health worker will now see what is expected.
plan.forPatientHint: Your practitioner has asked for these recordings.
plan.notFoundHint: They may be assigned to another practitioner.
plan.unreadableHint: It was saved by an older version of the app. Create a new plan to replace it.
plan.loadFailed: Could not load the monitoring plan

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Things the app noticed that a person should look at
alerts.emptyHint: Alerts about your patients will appear here.
alerts.closeNoteHint: Closing an alert records a decision, so it needs a reason.
alerts.notPermittedHint: This queue is not available in your role.
alerts.observationNote: The app reports what it observed between recordings. What it means for this patient is for you to decide.
alerts.loadFailedBody: The information could not be read from this device. Nothing has been lost. This is not the same as there being nothing here.

alertType.NEW_ABNORMAL: A pattern was flagged that was not flagged before
alertType.NEW_ABNORMAL_body: At {{location}}, the app reported a respiratory sound pattern worth a closer look. It did not report one there at the previous recording.
alertType.PERSISTENT_ABNORMAL: The same pattern keeps being flagged
alertType.PERSISTENT_ABNORMAL_body: At {{location}}, the app has reported a pattern worth a closer look in the last {{count}} assessments in a row.
alertType.SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE_body: At {{location}}, a change in respiratory sound pattern was detected between these recordings. The app cannot say whether that is better or worse.
alertType.MISSED_MONITORING: An expected assessment has not happened
alertType.MISSED_MONITORING_body: The plan asks for an assessment every {{intervalDays}} days. The last one was {{elapsedDays}} days ago.
alertType.REPEATED_POOR_QUALITY_body: {{affectedVisits}} of the last {{ofVisits}} visits produced audio the app could not use. This usually means the stethoscope bell is not sealed against the skin, the room is too noisy, or the microphone is failing — it is not a finding about the patient.

trend.title: Trend over time
trend.subtitle: What was recorded at each visit
trend.notEnough: Not enough assessments to show a trend
trend.notEnoughHint: A trend needs at least two assessments. There is only one so far, and a line through a single point would not mean anything.
trend.severityUnavailableHint: The severity score is not part of this prototype. Nothing is being withheld and no value has been calculated.
trend.observationNote: This shows what the app reported at each visit. It is not a measure of whether the patient is getting better or worse.

error.MONITORING_NOT_FOUND: That is not available to you.
error.MONITORING_NOT_PERMITTED: You do not have permission to do that.
error.MONITORING_INVALID_INTERVAL: Enter how many days between assessments, from 1 to 365.
error.MONITORING_NO_LOCATIONS: Choose at least one lung location.
error.MONITORING_INVALID_DATE_RANGE: The end date cannot be before the start date.
error.MONITORING_NOTE_REQUIRED: Please say why no action is needed.
error.SAVE_FAILED: That could not be saved. Nothing was lost — try again.
